# Keymap frames (63 bytes each) from akko-capture13.txt, grouped by "## name". Each write is 03 01 (Fn layer) on Insert (key 00 62),
# echoed by the board and read back with 83 01; the comment above each frame is the vendor UI's label.
# lighting: mark 10 (Lighting & Special Keys). mouse-media: mark 12 (Media & Tools).
# fn-reset: mark 14, Reset next to Fn Layer (11 01, payload 01). fn-factory-read(-answers): the full Fn layer read right after it = the factory Fn layer.
